acceptance_criteria_assessment.criterion: README.md documents the v1.1 settings UI, allowlist, placement/size, verbosity, and inventory cache behavior.
evidence: Settings UI: README.md:44-71 documents the Dashboard -> Plugins -> ArrTags settings page, the elevation-gated save, runtime activation without restart for per-operation values, the construction-captured restart residual, last-valid retention + bounded secret-free activity-log rejection, and the bounded post-save reconciliation; independently confirmed by src/ArrTags/Plugin.cs:18 (IHasWebPages), :91 (GetPages), :124-172 (UpdateConfiguration validate -> persist -> activate -> notify -> post-save reconciliation) and src/ArrTags/Configuration/config.html:361-507.

Allowlist: README.md:107 documents case-insensitive exact match of the resolved value (not substring/wildcard), 'only removes an already-confirmed value', empty = no restriction, bound 32 entries/64 chars each; confirmed by src/ArrTags/Rendering/BadgeDefinition.cs:36,42 and BadgeSelectorResolver.IsAllowed.

Placement/size: README.md:96-97 documents Position (BottomLeft default; TopLeft/TopRight/BottomRight/Center) with the derived status-pill rule (top-right except TopRight -> top-left) and Size (Medium default; Small/Large multiplying the width-based scale); confirmed by src/ArrTags/Rendering/BadgePosition.cs, BadgeSize.cs and config.html:152-169.

Verbosity: README.md:90 documents LogVerbosity Off/Error/Warning(default)/Information/Debug/Trace, applies without restart, never changes the host log level or posters, bounded secret-free diagnostics; confirmed by src/ArrTags/Configuration/PluginConfiguration.cs:26 (default Warning) and docs/limitations.md SEC-5.

Inventory cache: README.md:191-201 documents one provider library read per connection across a reconciliation window, bulk file reads replacing per-item reads, webhook/reconciliation/TTL invalidation sources, remaining O(series)/sparse-window bounds, and that F1 is resolved at the integration-test level with live confirmation owned by task 14.3; matches docs/limitations.md:106-163 (F1 resolved).

Removed stale claims: targeted grep of README.md for 'no web configuration UI'/'restart required to apply'/'read only at startup' returned no match; the four restart mentions (README.md:31,40,173,175) are accurate plugin install/update steps only.
